title: Сложные относительные конструкции: of which, whereby, in which case

why: В русском мы легко строим длинные фразы с «из которых», «согласно которому», «в таком случае». В английском для этого есть особые конструкции: предлог + which/whom, whose, whereby. Они делают речь формальной и компактной — их любят в отчётах, договорах, статьях и серьёзных письмах.
formation: • количество + of which / of whom: two of whom, most of which, none of which
• whose + существительное: a company whose founder... (вместо «of which the founder»)
• предлог + which / whom: the meeting at which..., the person to whom...
• whereby = «посредством чего, согласно которому»: a system whereby...
• , in which case = «и в таком случае»: She may refuse, in which case...
• the extent to which = «в какой степени»
usage: 1. Число или часть + of which/whom (для вещей — which, для людей — whom):
We interviewed ten people, two of whom were developers. (Мы опросили десять человек, двое из которых были разработчиками.)
He wrote many emails, most of which were ignored. (Он написал много писем, большинство из которых проигнорировали.)
2. Whose — принадлежность, и для людей, и для вещей:
It's a startup whose product is used worldwide. (Это стартап, чей продукт используется по всему миру.)
3. Whereby — правило, договорённость, метод, по которому что-то делается:
They introduced a policy whereby all staff can work remotely on Fridays. (Они ввели политику, по которой все сотрудники могут работать удалённо по пятницам.)
The person to whom I wrote never replied. (Человек, которому я писал, так и не ответил.)
5. In which case — продолжение мысли с последствием:
The flight may be cancelled, in which case you will get a refund. (Рейс могут отменить, и в этом случае вам вернут деньги.)
signalWords: Запятая перед of which/of whom/in which case; слова вроде «из которых», «согласно которому», «в таком случае», «в какой степени».
mistakes: ✗ most of them are old (после запятой, как продолжение фразы) → ✓ most of which are old (of them не соединяет предложения, нужен относительный оборот)
✗ the book which cover is red → ✓ the book whose cover is red (which не показывает принадлежность)
✗ the woman with who I work → ✓ the woman with whom I work (после предлога — whom)
✗ a system whereby in which users log in → ✓ a system whereby users log in (whereby уже содержит предлог, второй не нужен)
✗ in that case which → ✓ in which case (в этом обороте порядок фиксирован)
remember: Часть + of which/whom, принадлежность — whose, «по которому» — whereby, «и тогда» — in which case.

items.prompt: She has three brothers, all of ___ work in IT.
items.answer: whom

items.prompt: We use a system ___ every change is reviewed by two people.
items.answer: whereby

items.prompt: The company, ___ founder lives in Berlin, is hiring.
items.answer: whose

items.prompt: The report contains many charts, most of ___ are useless.
items.answer: which

items.prompt: The manager to ___ I sent the file is on holiday.
items.answer: whom

items.prompt: You may need a visa, in ___ case you should apply early.
items.answer: which

items.prompt: The meeting at ___ we discussed the budget was long.
items.answer: which

items.prompt: He made several promises, none of ___ he kept.
items.answer: which

exercises.instruction: Соедините предложения, используя слово в скобках

items.prompt: We have 20 servers. Half of them are old. (of which)
items.answer: We have 20 servers, half of which are old.

items.prompt: The team agreed on a rule. By this rule, every bug must be logged. (whereby)
items.answer: The team agreed on a rule whereby every bug must be logged.

items.prompt: The author wrote five books. The last of them won a prize. (of which)
items.answer: The author wrote five books, the last of which won a prize.

items.prompt: I met a woman. Her son works at Google. (whose)
items.answer: I met a woman whose son works at Google.

items.prompt: She may refuse. If she refuses, we will ask someone else. (in which case)
items.answer: She may refuse, in which case we will ask someone else.

items.prompt: There are 30 candidates. Only five of them have experience. (of whom)
items.answer: There are 30 candidates, only five of whom have experience.

items.prompt: The person was very kind. I spoke to her at the desk. (to whom)
items.answer: The person to whom I spoke at the desk was very kind.

items.prompt: I was surprised by how much the product had changed. (the extent to which)
items.answer: I was surprised by the extent to which the product had changed.

items.prompt: The project, ___ budget was cut, was cancelled. (a) whose (b) which (c) who
items.answer: (a) whose

items.prompt: He has two cars, ___ are red. (a) both of which (b) both of them
items.answer: (a) both of which

items.prompt: She gave me advice, ___ I ignored. (a) that (b) which
items.answer: (b) which

items.prompt: The man ___ I spoke is a lawyer. (a) to who (b) to whom
items.answer: (b) to whom

items.prompt: Many guests came, ___ were my friends. (a) some of whom (b) some of which
items.answer: (a) some of whom

items.prompt: We have a policy ___ employees can work from home. (a) whereby (b) whereas
items.answer: (a) whereby

items.prompt: She may be late, ___ case start without her. (a) in which (b) in that
items.answer: (a) in which

items.prompt: We have a plan, the details ___ are secret. (a) of that (b) of which
items.answer: (b) of which

items.prompt: The book, which cover is red, is mine.
items.answer: The book, whose cover is red, is mine.

items.prompt: He has many friends, most of them live abroad.
items.answer: He has many friends, most of whom live abroad.

items.prompt: The woman with who I work is Spanish.
items.answer: The woman with whom I work is Spanish.

items.prompt: There is a system whereby in which users log in with a key.
items.answer: There is a system whereby users log in with a key.

items.prompt: She has two sons, both of who are doctors.
items.answer: She has two sons, both of whom are doctors.

items.prompt: The office, in that I work, is small.
items.answer: The office, in which I work, is small.

items.prompt: I read three articles, none of that were useful.
items.answer: I read three articles, none of which were useful. / I read three articles, none of which was useful.

items.prompt: He may call, in this case tell him I'm busy.
items.answer: He may call, in which case tell him I'm busy.

items.prompt: У нас три разработчика, двое из которых работают удалённо.
items.answer: We have three developers, two of whom work remotely.

items.prompt: Это компания, основатель которой когда-то работал в Google.
items.answer: This is a company whose founder once worked at Google.

items.prompt: Мы ввели правило, согласно которому весь код проверяется.
items.answer: We introduced a rule whereby all code is reviewed.

items.prompt: Он может опоздать, и в этом случае мы начнём без него.
items.answer: He may be late, in which case we will start without him.

items.prompt: Человек, которому я написал, не ответил.
items.answer: The person to whom I wrote did not reply.

items.prompt: Она задала много вопросов, на большинство из которых никто не смог ответить.
items.answer: She asked many questions, most of which nobody could answer.

items.prompt: Отель, в котором мы остановились, был очень чистым.
items.answer: The hotel in which we stayed was very clean.

items.prompt: Баг, из-за которого сайт упал, уже исправлен.
items.answer: The bug because of which the site crashed has already been fixed.
